patch.value: pm get --json omits the whole item as budget-infeasible when its standard projection exceeds the default ceiling although the contract's own brief depth fits, so one active item is unreadable by default

## Observed
pm get pm-5t33or --json exits 2 with output_budget_exceeded.reason requested_budget_infeasible and omits the whole item, while pm get pm-5t33or (TOON), --depth brief and --depth deep all succeed, and --output-budget 20000 succeeds. The item's full JSON is 31,218 bytes (about 7.8k estimated tokens) against the default 6,000-token ceiling; it has 26 dependencies, a 2,725-character description and a 1,111-character body, no notes and no comments. The refusal receipt reports estimated_tokens 177 and within_budget false, so the number shown is the receipt's own size rather than the omitted result's.

## Population
Probed every active item on 2026-09-12: 308 of 309 open and draft items read at the default budget; pm-5t33or is the only refusal. The shape is rare today and structural: any single-entity read whose standard projection exceeds the ceiling has no degradation step between full standard and omit everything, although the contract declares brief as a cheaper amount dimension for the same command.

## Why it matters
pm get is the command an agent uses to rebuild an item; a default read that refuses outright is the one outcome the output-budget feature pm-5t33or exists to prevent (degrade deterministically instead of emitting unbounded output). pm-3crymx closed the same receipt defect for context; this is its shape on get.

## Non-goals
Not a change to the default ceiling. Not linked files/tests/docs projection (pm-tld20c, closed).

The single-entity degradation ladder steps standard to brief before omission and the receipt records the applied depth and the reason; The refusal receipt reports the omitted result's estimated tokens, never the receipt's own size; A probe over every active item returns exit 0 at the default budget, with a negative control for an item whose brief projection also exceeds the ceiling; A spec reproduces pm-5t33or's shape: 26 dependencies and a 2,700-character description under the default budget

A single-entity read whose standard projection exceeds the ceiling degrades to the declared brief projection and reports the applied depth; the receipt's estimated_tokens names the omitted result's size.
pm get pm-5t33or --json exits 2 requested_budget_infeasible with estimated_tokens 177 while --depth brief, --depth deep, TOON and --output-budget 20000 all succeed.
